title: Finite normalization of a complete discrete valuation ring
statement: Let $A$ be a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], complete for its maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_A$ [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], with fraction field $K$. Let $L/K$ be a finite field extension [def-pc-field-extension], meaning finite-dimensional as a $K$-vector space [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Let $C\subseteq L$ be the integral closure of $A$ in $L$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure], namely all elements satisfying a monic polynomial over $A$. Then $C$ is a discrete valuation ring, has fraction field $L$, is finite as an $A$-module, and is complete for its own maximal ideal. The inclusion $A\hookrightarrow C$ is local: $\mathfrak m_C\cap A=\mathfrak m_A$. Moreover, if $V\subseteq L$ is any discrete valuation ring with fraction field $L$, containing $A$, and $A\hookrightarrow V$ is local in this same sense, then $V=C$. Neither separability of $L/K$ nor perfectness of the residue field of $A$ is assumed.
